ticket.title: storypole-mcp exposes no park, unpark or reopen, so an agent working through MCP cannot hold a ticket
ticket.description: SP-47 added park, unpark and reopen to the library and the CLI on 2026-11-10, and deliberately left the MCP surface alone because the ticket acceptance named the CLI. The consequence is that the half of the harness that works through MCP cannot hold a ticket: dispatch.rs exposes storypole_verify and storypole_claim and has no tools for the three transitions, so an agent told to park a task has to drop to a shell and the call it makes is invisible to the MCP trace. The verbs are already the right shape for tools - ticket identifier in, status out - so this is wiring plus the schema entries plus tests. Acceptance: storypole_park, storypole_unpark and storypole_reopen appear in the tool list, each refuses the same illegal transitions the library refuses, and a tools/call round trip parks and unparks one task.

events.description:
SP-47 added park, unpark and reopen to the library and the CLI on 2026-11-10, and deliberately left the MCP surface alone because the ticket acceptance named the CLI. The consequence is that the half of the harness that works through MCP cannot hold a ticket: dispatch.rs exposes storypole_verify and storypole_claim and has no tools for the three transitions, so an agent told to park a task has to drop to a shell and the call it makes is invisible to the MCP trace. The verbs are already the right shape for tools - ticket identifier in, status out - so this is wiring plus the schema entries plus tests. Acceptance: storypole_park, storypole_unpark and storypole_reopen appear in the tool list, each refuses the same illegal transitions the library refuses, and a tools/call round trip parks and unparks one task.

DELIVERED AND VERIFIED 2026-11-10 (storypole b737131). storypole_park, storypole_unpark and storypole_reopen are listed and dispatched; they are the library calls plus argument reading, so they refuse exactly what the library refuses - parking a verified task, a held claim or an archived one, and reopening without a reason, which the wire schema marks required as well. Schemas moved to schema_lifecycle.rs at 47 lines when schema.rs reached 278, following the shape schema_plan.rs already demonstrates. Three tests: advertised, a dispatch round trip that parks and unparks one task, and a reopen without a reason refused. Tier 2: fmt clean, clippy -p storypole-mcp --all-targets -D warnings clean, lifecycle_tools 3/3, miter audit 0 over 250, and the chain that produced the receipt below also ran the workspace-wide nextest and docs check.
